desc: Derive the reduction: for column mask `m`, each row contributes `min(popcount(r xor m), W-popcount(r xor m))`.
Identify the total objective as XOR convolution of row-mask frequencies with the radial kernel.
Implement frequency compression, Walsh–Hadamard transforms, inverse normalization, and minimum extraction in Python.
Validate the implementation on all provided sample tests.
Confirm time and memory complexity meet `H <= 2e5`, `W <= 18`.
